definitions.gloss: mine tunnel; gallery; underground passage in a mine
definitions.explanation: A horizontal or inclined passage dug underground for mining or military purposes.

examples.japanese: {廃鉱|はいこう}の{坑道|こうどう}が{観光地|かんこうち}として{整備|せいび}された。
examples.english: The tunnels of an abandoned mine were developed as a tourist attraction.

examples.japanese: {坑道|こうどう}の{奥|おく}は{暗|くら}くて{湿気|しっけ}が{多|おお}く、ヘルメットなしでは{危険|きけん}だ。
examples.english: Deep inside the mine tunnel it is dark and humid, and it's dangerous without a helmet.

notes: Note the homophone distinction: {坑道|こうどう} (mine tunnel) vs {行動|こうどう} (action) vs {講堂|こうどう} (lecture hall/auditorium). The kanji {坑|こう} specifically relates to mines and excavation. Common collocations: {坑道|こうどう}を{掘|ほ}る (to dig a mine tunnel), {坑道|こうどう}{内|ない} (inside the tunnel). In military usage, refers to underground passages or siege tunnels. Related: {炭鉱|たんこう} (coal mine), {鉱山|こうざん} (mine — the site), {採掘|さいくつ} (mining, excavation).
